meta.name: xiaohongshu-mcp
meta.description: Automate Xiaohongshu (RedNote) content operations using a Python client for the xiaohongshu-mcp server. Use for: (1) Publishing image, text, and video content, (2) Searching for notes and trends, (3) Analyzing post details and comments, (4) Managing user profiles and content feeds. Triggers: xiaohongshu automation, rednote content, publish to xiaohongshu, xiaohongshu search, social media management.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动化发布小红书图文视频内容并分析趋势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要批量管理小红书账号的内容发布与数据监控。
copy.tagline_en: Automate Xiaohongshu content publishing and trend analysis
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to batch manage Xiaohongshu content publishing and data monitoring.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以帮你自动发布图文、视频到小红书，搜索笔记和热门话题，查看笔记详情和评论，以及管理用户主页和内容流。
howto.when: 当你提到“小红书自动化”、“发布到小红书”、“搜索小红书”等关键词，或要求进行小红书内容运营时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索小红书上的“咖啡”笔记。
say.note: Claude 会调用搜索命令，返回相关笔记列表。

say.text: 发布一篇标题为“周末探店”的图文笔记。
say.note: Claude 会调用发布命令，上传图片和文字。

say.text: 查看这篇笔记的详情和评论。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate publishing images, text, and videos to Xiaohongshu, search for notes and trends, analyze post details and comments, and manage user profiles and content feeds.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'xiaohongshu automation', 'publish to xiaohongshu', 'xiaohongshu search', or request content operations on Xiaohongshu.

say_en.note: Claude will run the search command and return results.

say_en.text: Publish a note titled 'Weekend Exploration' with images.
say_en.note: Claude will call the publish command with images and text.

say_en.text: Get details and comments of this note.
say_en.note: Requires note ID and token; Claude will fetch full content.
